firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Sharing the code behind our Paper Track writeup, as the rules ask for publicly shared code.

DesignGrad runs Gemma 4 26B offline on a laptop and has it design mechanical parts as CadQuery code. A critic's review becomes textual gradients that revise the design, and three kinds of feedback are added cumulatively: conceptual (the design document), numerical (analysis code that the agent writes and runs itself) and visual (rendered views of the built part). After the loop has finished, independent tests score every design.

Repository: https://github.com/sinansahincandan/designgrad

It holds the loop, ten problems with their independent tests, the records of every reported run (each model call, design, built part, measurement and critique), and scripts that rescore the runs and redraw the paper's figures without running the model.

Paper: https://github.com/sinansahincandan/designgrad/blob/main/paper/DesignGrad_v4.pdf
